NEXT (continuing now): SWORD III Part F item 4 (reset the success bar to a derived IC 0.02-0.05 threshold) and pre-registering W-1's three alternatives per Rule III-15, before any run happens -- both doable without live testing. Items 1/3 (per-component IC, magnitude IC) need one more live run to actually produce data under the new instrumentation -- queued pending your go-ahead.
